answer: Work waits on the relic until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ledge of the next round. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the oasis of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
